plugin_desc: Ifotec industrial fiber-optic transceiver and optical transmission SNMP child template for devices under enterprise PEN 21362. The shared Transmission SNMP floor supplies MIB-II uptime and IF-MIB 64-bit HC interface traffic. This child adds the confirmed ifoTemperatureTable chassis and module temperature from IFOTEC-SMI as device_temperature_celsius, scaled from tenths of a degree Celsius. CPU, memory, fan and power-supply health are N/A because no stable shared device-health objects are confirmed for them.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Ifotec chassis or module temperature in degrees Celsius. The SNMP table reports tenths of a degree, so the query divides the raw ifoTempValue by 10 before display and alert evaluation. High values can indicate cooling problems, high ambient temperature or overloaded hardware.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
